subject: Kobold Shrine-Keeper
picture: All-ages fantasy coloring book page, portrait. Outline art only. Keep the same small scaly kobold shrine-keeper with a tail and cranial ridges, raising one plain coin. Coins are large empty circles with a simple rim only. No letters, no numbers, no words, no S, no OPE. The altar is a simple stone block. On the altar is one small animal skull prop: two eye holes and a snout, no teeth row, no second living dragon head. Cave ceiling, large floor slabs, a fully closed wooden door in the back wall. Bold even outlines. No black frame, no black fills, no blank doorway.
